sections.description: The only change is a page-break artifact (page number 10 and a Table of Contents link) that now falls at the end of this risk factor; the catastrophic events text is word-for-word identical.

A.rationale: Minor: the only difference is page-layout residue; there is no change in wording, substance, likelihood, scope or numbers, so no criterion 1 to 4 applies.

B.rationale: Minor: the change is a page-break and layout artifact, not a change in wording, so no criterion applies; it is closest to a cross-reference or punctuation change.

sections.current_heading: Commodity price changes, material price increases, fluctuations in demand for our products and services, significant disruptions to our supply chains or significant shortages of labor and material may adversely impact our financial results or our ability to meet commitments to customers.
sections.description: The page-break artifact (page number 10 and a Table of Contents link) that split the first sentence mid-word in the prior year is gone; the commodity, supply chain and monetary/fiscal policy text is otherwise identical.

A.rationale: Minor: removal of page-layout residue with identical meaning; no new or dropped risk, event, characterization or number, so no criterion 1 to 4 applies.

B.rationale: Minor: the only change is removing a page-break artifact, with every word of the risk disclosure unchanged, so no criterion applies.

sections.description: The page-break artifact (page number 11 and a Table of Contents link) moved from after the last bullet to between the tariffs bullet and the trade agreements bullet; the list of political, economic and trade risks is unchanged.

A.rationale: Minor: only the position of page-layout residue changed; every bullet and sentence is identical, so no criterion 1 to 4 applies.

B.rationale: Minor: the page-break artifact moved position only, with no risk, jurisdiction or bullet added or dropped, so no criterion applies.
